summary: Anza Renewables is the existing Anza RE, LLC U.S. operating company, not a separate Canadian platform. ECP's Energy Transition Opportunities Fund, Angeleno Group and unnamed investors funded the completed May 2023 Borrego separation; exact stakes, control, vehicle and legal close date remain undisclosed. The record should use the United States, Oakland headquarters and official Anza website, remove Canada, and preserve Borrego, New Leaf and Anza RE Buyer as separate former-parent, sister-platform and vehicle boundaries.
